en: The image depicts a vintage, partially damaged postcard with three nude women arranged in an artistic, symbolic pose. The women appear posed to resemble a classical or mythological motif, possibly referencing the figure of Atlas holding the world but reinterpreted with feminine forms. The background is uniformly dark, and the photograph has a soft, painterly quality typical of early 20th-century European art postcards. The top left corner has the faint inscription 'Un con...' and a small publisher or artist monogram appears in the lower left corner. The image is black and white, or sepia-toned.
